strings.en: Sorry to have kept you waiting, everyone.
Launch preparations took longer than expected.
Good to see you again, Commander Hazuki. ...You look well too, Amuro.
Sorry for calling you all the way to the Moon.
It seems the hostile forces on the surface have been swept away.
Naturally we'd come up here.
You defeated the Mykene Empire and the Demon Empire, right!
That's Commander Hazuki for you! Earth's peace is in good hands!
Ha ha ha, you shouldn't flatter your elders so, Captain Misumaru.
I hear you had a rough time on Mars with Captains Burning and Quattro.
Oh... I'm sorry for rushing off on my own...
Well, Captain Bright and the others already gave you a good chewing out.
So don't get too down about it.
That must've been rough. Did he "correct" you too?
Correct...?
I don't know either... Maybe it's a military custom.
Huh? I-I wasn't dressed so badly I'd need censoring... was I!?
...Aren't you misunderstanding something?
Seems even Captain Bright didn't "correct" Captain Misumaru.
Ahem...
In any case, the surface threats being gone is good news for us.
We've also dealt damage to hostile forces around Mars...
and wiping out the Gaizok in particular is a big achievement.
Too bad the Gaizok business left such a bad aftertaste, though...
And with the ruins the Nadesico had to leave behind,
the Mars sphere can't be called safe yet.
I've looked over the report...
So the Meganoids are occupying the Martian ruins. That's worrying.
I'm told they were already occupied by the time we joined up...
My deepest apologies.
Oh... you don't need to apologize so much. When the Nadesico got to Mars,
they were already swarming all over, so don't worry, Princess Romina.
As it turned out, the Nadesico going rogue revealed what the Meganoids
were really after... The ruins, hm...
I've ordered Nergal to hand over their data on the ruins,
but...
what we heard from the Nadesico crew is more detailed, as it stands.
Given their track record, I doubt they'll hand it over so easily.
Means it's that juicy a prize. ...For the Meganoids, too.
If the Meganoids, who seek to rule humanity, could warp freely...
it would be terrifying.
Moreover, once they learn such an important technology exists...
the Gyandlar and the Bunker will surely target those ruins as well.
Then shall we hurry back to Mars?
Bright, how are things around Earth?
Hmm... Rom's concern is well founded, but...
even though we've driven off the Vega Star Federation,
the situation is far from letting us head for Mars.
The threat of the Gyandlar and the Bunker...
And the Campbellians seem to still have forces in space.
And the Jovians can apparently show up wherever they like...
Neo Zeon, which has been lying low lately,
will surely seize the opening if we leave Earth.
They've left the surface, but... the Muge Empire seems to be regrouping.
Mostly aliens, then.
...Yes, Captain. What became of Neo Japan's Ulube and the others?
Right, that.
...Major Ulube and Dr. Mikamura have both been taken into custody.
Rain went to see them. ...However...
However...?
The wrecked Devil Gundam's whereabouts are a total mystery.
What? Ulube and the others won't talk?
No, it seems they don't know either.
Nothing has been seen leaving that area since.
There's no way we wouldn't find it, and yet...
Turn ourselves in?
That's right.
Turn ourselves in? We've already been arrested, haven't we? Heh heh...
Cyborg decoys made of DG Cells...
We can't keep stalling forever! So we might as well...
Losing your nerve, at this late stage?
No! ...My daughter woke me up...
That's a problem. My plan would come to nothing.
What more do you intend to do?
The Devil Gundam was destroyed.
It was blown off somewhere. No one even knows where it is.
Give up your foolish ambitions.
Did you think I wouldn't know?
Besides... it's been found. A new unit.
What!?
And furthermore... after seeing this, can you still say you're out?
Impossible...! Rain...!?
She's merely unconscious. ...She came waltzing in alone, you see.
What do you intend to do with Rain... with my daughter?
...It is the conclusion of exhaustive research.
A human with healthy, powerful life force is suited to that unit.
A being with the power to create life for the next generation.
Don't tell me... Rain...!
The one best suited to be the living unit... stands atop all life,
and can keep bearing and multiplying new life...
...Thy name... is Woman!!
Everyone's here. Now, about our next course of action...
Emergency message for everyone.
Ruri!?
Sorry to interrupt. A suspicious transmission's in. Putting it through.
Attention, Londo Bell!
I am the ruler of the world, Ulube Ishikawa.
Domon!?
Ulube!? Why!? Rain said he'd been captured...
Ulube Ishikawa...?
I thought he was a major in Neo Japan...
Everyone! As you know, the Earth Sphere is in unprecedented peril.
Therefore, I declare the unification of the Earth Sphere in my name!
Huh? What's this geezer going on about?
Unification of the Earth Sphere... Whoa, whoa!
Have no fear.
For henceforth, the world shall forever belong to Neo Japan.
There will be no more need for foolish power struggles like war.
Hey, that man... he's giving off a really nasty aura.
I can't sense auras, but... I've got a bad feeling...
We're busy here!
Quit stalling and spit out what you want!
Fwahahahahaha...!!
Very well. Rather than words, I shall show you reality.
Arise! Devil Gundam!!
What! What did you just say!!
Wh-!? What!? This footage is...!
Hey, that's... it's latched onto the Neo Japan colony!
No! If it keeps growing like that...!
This is... the Devil Gundam's tentacles, reaching Earth...!?
Nfu-hahahaha... Now, the world shall kneel before me!
......I refuse!!
Hm? ...It's you, Domon Kasshu... All has gone according to my plan.
Your love for your father fully drew out your abilities as a Fighter.
Thank you. Because of you, I was able to obtain this.
What!? You... don't tell me you planned this from the start...!
No faaair!
How... cunning!
Ulube! You never learn! Again and again!
Heh heh heh... And what do you intend to do about it?
Until I destroy the Devil Gundam completely this time!
I'll burn every last DG Cell to ash!
Heh heh heh... Can you really do that, I wonder?
What...
That footage... inside the Devil Gundam... it's Rain!!
R... Rain!?
Hahahahahaha! My research paid off!
The Devil Gundam revives apace, with a woman as its living unit!
You and Rain parting ways
ended up completing my plan.
So Rain really is inside the Devil Gundam...?
Th... that's horrible...!
Ulube...! You, I will never forgive!
Using someone's sweetheart... that's unforgivable!
A disgrace to all warriors... Justice demands he be punished!
Heh, such spirit... But how long will it last?
Heh heh heh heh... Hahahahaha! Wahahahahaha!!
...The transmission's been cut.
Captain Bright, looks like our next stop's decided before the meeting...!
Yes...
I never imagined things would come to this, though...
Latching onto a colony, huh...
Size-wise, it's the biggest opponent we've had yet.
No wonder we couldn't find it.
...When the Einst appeared at the Neo Japan colony before,
was it because they foresaw this?
...One who tramples people and the land they live on for his own desires...
I cannot forgive!
At that scale...
there's no way we can afford to split up our forces.
Yes...
All right, all of Londo Bell will head for the Neo Japan colony!
All hands, take alert stations!
Huh, where's Big Bro Domon?
He's already rushed off.
From the Neo Japan colony... this many...!?
The Devil Gundam has completely taken it over...
Ruri, how's the Aestivalis team deployment?
All units deployed and awaiting the order to attack.
But... will our attacks even work on something like that...
What are you saying!? We have no choice, do we?
If that thing latches onto other colonies, or Earth...
But... honestly, even with all of Londo Bell's forces...
If we all work together, we can do it!
All our allies appear to be ready.
Still... the power of DG Cells... to think it's this great...
As a fellow scientist, I can't help but feel awe toward Dr. Kasshu.
But when it's that tasteless, I don't even feel like explaining it...
...A Devil Colony, you might call it.
Not funny.
Still... it's a name that suits that thing perfectly...
Captain Bright, there's no point just watching.
Let's attack.
Right.
...All units, all ships, hit the Devil Colony with everything you've got!
Oh, let me tell you one thing. This Devil Colony
regenerates faster than your attacks can destroy it!
Heh heh heh, care to try?
Ulube! That's just a bluff!
Devil Gundam aside,
destroying a colony with numbers like ours is unrealistic to begin with.
If it regenerates... that goes without saying.
Damn! Is this the end...!?
It's all right! Because...
That's right, it's all right... There's still a way.
What? A transmission... that voice...?
You can't beat this demon from outside. Yes, its one weakness
is an attack from inside the Devil Gundam's own body!
Mr. Mikamura!?
As I thought... attacks from outside won't work.
Damn you, Mikamura, you'd betray me!?
Hmph, but what can one old fool do by struggling... Ugh!
...No! Curses, so that's his plan!
Listen, I'm going to release Dr. Kasshu now.
My father!?
Hey, that emergency hatch! The shutter's opening!
Is Dr. Mikamura in there?
To you, father and son, I am beyond forgiveness...
I am truly sorry.
And I have no right to ask this of you now, but...
Please, my daughter... save my daughter!
She's not to blame. It was all my fault!!
Mr. Mikamura... Mr. Mikamura!!
Domon Kasshu!
The doctor means to use that emergency hatch as our way in!
We'll cover you here. Meanwhile, break through to the inside!
All riiight!
This hand of mine burns red! Its roar tells me to save Rain!
Erupting! God Fingerrrr!!
All right, everyone, follow Domon Kasshu! Into the Devil Colony!
Yeah! Let's raise some hell in that monster's gut!
Right. Ra Cailum, prepare to breach! All hands, brace for impact!
The Elshank shall follow as well.
Wait for me... Father! Raaaaain!!
Nadesico, setting course for entry.
Say, Captain, when you said it'd be all right, what were you going to say?
You seemed confident we could beat it...
A captive princess, you see,
is always destined to be rescued by her prince!
A prince...
......Quite a hot-blooded prince, isn't he...
Then the Nadesico's going in too!
